comment: * Holder for FLAC metadata. * * @see FLAC format * METADATA_BLOCK_STREAMINFO * @see FLAC format * METADATA_BLOCK_SEEKTABLE * @see FLAC format * METADATA_BLOCK_VORBIS_COMMENT * @see FLAC format * METADATA_BLOCK_PICTURE

variables.name: NOT_IN_LOOKUP_TABLE
variables.comment: Indicates that a value is not in the corresponding lookup table.

variables.name: SEPARATOR
variables.comment: Separator between the field name of a Vorbis comment and the corresponding value.

variables.name: minBlockSizeSamples
variables.comment: Minimum number of samples per block.

variables.name: maxBlockSizeSamples
variables.comment: Maximum number of samples per block.

variables.name: minFrameSize
variables.comment: Minimum frame size in bytes, or 0 if the value is unknown.

variables.name: maxFrameSize
variables.comment: Maximum frame size in bytes, or 0 if the value is unknown.

variables.name: sampleRateLookupKey
variables.comment:
* Lookup key corresponding to the stream sample rate, or {@link #NOT_IN_LOOKUP_TABLE} if it is * not in the lookup table. * *

This key is used to indicate the sample rate in the frame header for the most common values. * *

The sample rate lookup table is described in https://xiph.org/flac/format.html#frame_header.

variables.name: bitsPerSampleLookupKey
variables.comment:
* Lookup key corresponding to the number of bits per sample of the stream, or {@link * #NOT_IN_LOOKUP_TABLE} if it is not in the lookup table. * *

This key is used to indicate the number of bits per sample in the frame header for the most * common values. * *

The sample size lookup table is described in https://xiph.org/flac/format.html#frame_header.

variables.name: totalSamples
variables.comment: Total number of samples, or 0 if the value is unknown.

variables.name: seekTable
variables.comment: Seek table, or {@code null} if it is not provided.

variables.name: metadata
variables.comment: Content metadata, or {@code null} if it is not provided.

methods.name: public int getMaxDecodedFrameSize()
methods.comment: Returns the maximum size for a decoded frame from the FLAC stream.

methods.name: public int getDecodedBitrate()
methods.comment: Returns the bitrate of the stream after it's decoded into PCM.

methods.name: public long getDurationUs()
methods.comment:
* Returns the duration of the FLAC stream in microseconds, or {@link C#TIME_UNSET} if the total
   * number of samples if unknown.

methods.name: public long getSampleNumber(long timeUs)
methods.comment:
* Returns the sample number of the sample at a given time.
   *
   * @param timeUs Time position in microseconds in the FLAC stream.
   * @return The sample number corresponding to the time position.

methods.name: public long getApproxBytesPerFrame()
methods.comment: Returns the approximate number of bytes per frame for the current FLAC stream.

methods.name: public Format getFormat(byte[] streamMarkerAndInfoBlock, @Nullable Metadata id3Metadata)
methods.comment:
* Returns a {@link Format} extracted from the FLAC stream metadata. * *

{@code streamMarkerAndInfoBlock} is updated to set the bit corresponding to the stream info * last metadata block flag to true. * * @param streamMarkerAndInfoBlock An array containing the FLAC stream marker followed by the * stream info block. * @param id3Metadata The ID3 metadata of the stream, or {@code null} if there is no such data. * @return The extracted {@link Format}.

methods.name: public Metadata getMetadataCopyWithAppendedEntriesFrom(@Nullable Metadata other)
methods.comment: Returns a copy of the content metadata with entries from {@code other} appended.

methods.name: public FlacStreamMetadata copyWithSeekTable(@Nullable SeekTable seekTable)
methods.comment: Returns a copy of {@code this} with the seek table replaced by the one given.

methods.name: public FlacStreamMetadata copyWithVorbisComments(List<String> vorbisComments)
methods.comment: Returns a copy of {@code this} with the given Vorbis comments added to the metadata.

methods.name: public FlacStreamMetadata copyWithPictureFrames(List<PictureFrame> pictureFrames)
methods.comment: Returns a copy of {@code this} with the given picture frames added to the metadata.

methods.name: private static Metadata buildMetadata(List<String> vorbisComments, List<PictureFrame> pictureFrames)
